description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Stryker is a global leader in medical technology focused on healthcare innovation. The Software Engineer, Applications will support the development and maintenance of application software and design documentation for robotic-assisted surgery products. The role collaborates with cross-functional teams to develop safe, robust, and user-friendly software under established engineering and quality processes.
Software engineer developing and testing application controls and user interfaces for robotic surgical systems

Responsibilities:
• Support and contribute to the design and implementation of application software that controls, navigates, and serves as the user interface for robotic surgical systems using Agile software development methodologies
• Support and execute software product development activities under supervision in accordance with defined requirements and architecture, while adhering to established design principles and coding standards
• Collaborate effectively with members of R&D, Quality, Marketing, and Project Management to ensure project success as a member of a Scrum team
• Under supervision, follow established Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) procedures and guidelines to ensure software quality through code reviews, unit and component testing, code analysis, and defect management
• Assist in refining software engineering documentation in accordance with R&D procedures and the Quality Management System (QMS)

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Software, Computer Engineering / Computer Science or related discipline
• 0+ years of work experience
• 3.0 minimum cumulative GPA (or equivalent)
• Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. and not require employment-based sponsorship now or in the future
• Knowledge of computer science fundamentals, including data structures and algorithms
• Exposure to C++ and object-oriented programming
• Self-starter with demonstrated efficient work methods, analytical & problem-solving skills, and ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
• Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively work cross-functionally and externally as required

Preferred:
• Experience with integrated development environments (IDEs) for projects
• Exposure to the Qt/QML framework, Linux, Docker, and version control systems
• Knowledge of SDLC and Agile software development
• Experience with tools for static/dynamic software analysis, memory management, unit testing, and code coverage
• Experience with or coursework in linear algebra, computational geometry, computer graphics, software architecture, image processing, and robotics
